inputs: actual play and competition conditions
actual sport's applicable competition rules
outputs: official's checked current ruling and intended participants or other officials

steps.what: Officiate by communicating the checked rulings and directions to maintain standards of play and ensure game rules are observed
inputs: official's checked current ruling and intended participants or other officials
outputs: actual communicated rulings and directions during the event

steps.what: Enter actual required match results and incidents in the existing official match form, reconcile fixture identity and check the complete record and destination
inputs: actual communicated rulings and directions during the event
official's actual observed results/incidents
actual fixture identity and required match-form fields
outputs: exact checked actual match record and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure retained fixture/team context in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the official match-form application, where actual required results and incidents are recorded. The official observes, decides and communicates rulings personally and enters/checks every actual match fact before the separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated fixture context entry can surround actual required match recording.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fixture-linked match forms can retain existing event identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Live observation, rule application and maintaining standards of play remain human work.
tasks.human_edge: Read the actual event and apply the rule in its competitive context.

ambition.what: Reduce repeated context in an actual required match form.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixture-linked match forms can reuse event identifiers; live sports rulings and actual result entry still require the official.

assumptions: This is an actual officiating episode with a required existing match form, not an invented report for every informal game. Competition administration supplies real fixture/team identities; the official produces actual results/incidents and captures/checks them in s3.
No automatic tracking feed, inferred infraction or inferred score is assumed. Missing facts and identity conflicts require manual resolution. Existing fixture context removes the gain.
Shares 55/25/19/1 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 1.9 minus 0.75 hours of context upkeep leaves 1.15 net. Negligible save is fully retained.
Each live ruling is checked in s1 before its actual communication in s2; changed play or wording requires renewed judgment. The final record is checked as ordinary entry work in s3.

Do not add the same live ruling/signal again from tasks 3915/3911, or the same incident record from task 3915, when they represent this episode. No external federation submission is promised by this internal-save scenario.
unknowns: Actual required form and existing fixture context
research_questions: Observe repeated fixture entry separately from actual scores and incident judgment.

tasks.short: Resolve rule complaints and assess penalties

steps.what: Hear actual participant claims of rule infractions or complaints and establish the observed facts and unresolved disagreements
inputs: actual participant complaint and observed event evidence
outputs: official-understood actual claim, facts and uncertainty

steps.what: Look up the applicable actual rule and penalty provision in the competition's official rule viewer (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: official-understood actual claim, facts and uncertainty
actual applicable rulebook/version supplied by the competition
outputs: official-selected actual rule text and relevant penalty provisions

steps.what: Resolve the actual claims or complaints and assess necessary penalties according to regulations; check the exact final ruling and intended recipients
inputs: official-understood actual claim, facts and uncertainty
official-selected actual rule text and relevant penalty provisions
outputs: official's exact checked complaint ruling, penalty and intended participants

steps.what: Communicate the exact checked complaint ruling and necessary penalty to the actual participants
inputs: official's exact checked complaint ruling, penalty and intended participants
outputs: actual communicated complaint resolution and penalty

steps.what: Record the actual complaint outcome and required incident details in the existing match form and check the complete entry and destination
inputs: actual communicated complaint resolution and penalty
actual fixture/participant identities and required incident fields
outputs: exact checked actual complaint/penalty entry and internal destination

steps.what: Save the exact checked complaint/penalty entry in the intended internal match-form revision
inputs: exact checked actual complaint/penalty entry and internal destination

tasks.design: Configure native rule-section bookmarks and retained fixture identifiers in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the competition rule viewer and match-form application. The official hears the claim, reads the actual provision and decides/communicates the ruling personally, then records/checks only the actual required incident entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual rule navigation and repeated match context can add handling during complaint resolution.
tasks.enabler_now: Native rule bookmarks and existing match-form context can reduce repeated navigation/identifiers.
tasks.still_hard: Disputed facts, interpretation and proportionate application remain with the official.
tasks.human_edge: Hear participants and resolve a complaint without turning uncertain evidence into certainty.

ambition.what: Reduce actual rule lookup and incident-context handling.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native rule bookmarks and fixture context can reduce lookup/entry; complaint findings and penalties require actual official judgment.

assumptions: This is an actual complaint requiring rule consultation and an existing incident entry; no extra report is invented. The competition supplies the actual rulebook/version and fixture records; the official produces facts/ruling and captures/checks them in s1/s3/s5.
No current sport-specific rule, penalty schedule or legal claim is supplied from memory. Missing or disputed provisions require actual manual resolution; no model chooses penalties.

Native bookmarks/context first; equivalent existing settings remove the gain. Shares 30/15/30/15/9/1 are unmeasured active effort; gross saving 4.5 + 0.9 = 5.4 minus 1 hour of bookmark/context upkeep leaves 4.4 net.

Actual ruling communication is fully retained and gated on the exact final ruling in s3. Negligible form save is fully retained; entry checking in s5 is ordinary recording. Changed content invalidates each gate.
Deduplicate the same ruling, signal and match incident against tasks 3909/3911 where they are the same actual episode. No external disciplinary submission is silently added.
unknowns: Actual rule-viewer use and required incident recording
research_questions: Measure real rule searches and context repetition without crediting ordinary ruling time.

steps.what: Observe actual play, infractions and competition conditions that may require a signal
inputs: actual sporting event and observed play
actual sport's applicable signal conventions
outputs: official's actual observed event and potential need to signal

steps.what: Choose and check the exact current signal, intended participants or officials and timing against the actual ruling and play
inputs: official's actual observed event and potential need to signal
actual ruling and sport's signal conventions
outputs: official's exact checked signal, recipients and timing for current play

steps.what: Signal participants or other officials to make them aware of infractions or otherwise regulate play or competition
inputs: official's exact checked signal, recipients and timing for current play
outputs: actual visible or audible signal communicated in current competition

tasks.design: Keep actual event observation, signal selection and physical communication with the official. Existing whistles, flags or communications equipment support the signal already; an automatic notification does not replace this live task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The signal must reflect a real ruling and current play at the right moment.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional software change to the actual signal is identified.
tasks.still_hard: Visibility, timing and ensuring the intended people understand the signal remain situational.
tasks.human_edge: Adapt the signal to the actual event and participants' response.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: live sports signals require actual observation, ruling and timely physical communication; ordinary signaling equipment is already part of the task.

assumptions: This task is actual signaling. No additional note, lookup, result entry or report is hidden in s3; required match/incident recording is explicitly decomposed in tasks 3909/3915 and must be counted only once for the same event.
No automatic event detection, tracking feed or structured signal trigger is assumed. The official produces the actual observations and final signal choice in s1/s2.
Native equipment settings cannot remove the live observation/choice/communication here. Existing whistles, flags and radio capability earn no new saving.
Shares 30/25/45 are unmeasured active effort; all remain. Gross/net saving and new upkeep are zero. Each changed ruling, recipient or play state returns to s2 before signaling.
research_questions: Observe whether a separate required electronic signal log exists; decompose actual capture only if present.

already_counted.description: Actual observation, signal decision and live communication remain.

incremental.description: No new process or maintenance introduced.

steps.what: Retrieve the actual applicable sport rules, competition variations and relevant examples from the official rule viewer (OPS_SYSTEM)
inputs: actual teaching question and sport/competition
actual rulebook/version maintained by the competition
outputs: official-selected actual rule passages and applicable examples

steps.what: Choose accurate explanations and examples suited to the actual learners and check them against the applicable rule text
inputs: official-selected actual rule passages and applicable examples
actual learners' questions and understanding
outputs: official's checked teaching explanation and examples

steps.what: Teach and explain the rules and regulations governing the specific sport, respond to actual questions and check learners' understanding
inputs: official's checked teaching explanation and examples
actual learners and their responses
outputs: actual rule explanation, learner questions and observed understanding

tasks.design: Configure native version-specific rule-section bookmarks in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the official rule viewer. The official reads the actual provisions, chooses accurate examples and teaches/responds to learners personally; no new handout or completion record is introduced.
tasks.previous_blocker: Finding the actual provision and competition variation can take repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native bookmarks can retain links to applicable rule sections.
tasks.still_hard: Learners' misconceptions and context-sensitive rule examples require an actual teacher.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why the rule applies to the learner's real example.

ambition.what: Reduce actual rule retrieval around teaching.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native rule bookmarks can reduce source navigation while accurate sport-rule teaching and answering learners remain human work.

assumptions: The actual teaching episode includes current provision lookup. The competition maintains the real rulebook/version; the official selects and checks actual passages in s1 and produces explanations in s2/s3.
No rule or regulation is invented or quoted from memory. Missing versions or conflicting variations require manual resolution. Existing equivalent bookmarks remove the gain.
No required report, handout send, enrolment or certification entry is hidden in the teaching step. If the actual session requires those, count their observed work separately.
Shares 20/20/60 are provisional unmeasured active effort. Gross saving 6 minus 1 hour of rule-bookmark upkeep leaves 5 net. Teaching remains fully retained.
unknowns: Actual current-rule lookup and existing bookmarks
research_questions: Measure repeated rule navigation separately from lesson reasoning and actual teaching.

already_counted.description: Actual source checking, accurate example preparation and live teaching remain.

incremental.description: Maintain bookmarks when competition rule versions change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 unmeasured range below provisional 5 percent net, conditional on actual repeated rule lookup.
